chunks: And with this chain of transmission, he said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “There is no surety in a hadd punishment.”

key_terms.حَدٍّ: a fixed prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, the source of this ruling
key_terms.كَفَالَةَ: surety, guarantee, or assuming responsibility on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "لَا كَفَالَةَ فِي حَدٍّ" mean in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله concerning hadd punishments. It indicates that legal surety or guarantee is not accepted in matters involving a fixed penal punishment.
